purpose: First self-gravitating cosmological hidden-state science gate. Test whether three initially n,rho,P-matched neutrino kinetic states FD/Fplus/Fminus respond differently to the identical finite-amplitude cold-matter fundamental Fourier mode over z=1.0 to z=0.95.
interpretation_boundary: Controlled periodic Newtonian cosmological initial-value problem in pinned SWIFT with a common frozen E9 expansion background. Not a full relativistic Einstein-Vlasov background-backreaction calculation, not a halo/HOD model, and not a survey detectability result.

cosmology.note: Omega_b remains in the background cosmology. For this DMO control, PartType1 carries the total non-neutrino matter density Omega_b+Omega_cdm; no hydrodynamic or baryonic subgrid physics is used.

mode.cold_lagrangian_map: x = q_x - s*(A/k)*sin(k q_x), y=q_y, z=q_z, with s=+1 or -1 and periodic wrapping.
mode.cold_initial_peculiar_velocity: zero by design; this is a controlled finite-amplitude response experiment, not a growing-mode cosmological IC.
mode.paired_cases: For every kinetic state and resolution run both s=+1 and s=-1. Neutrino positions, IDs, q quantiles and thermal directions are identical between the +/- mode runs.

phase_space_design.directions: Gaussian isotropic unit vectors generated for N/2 entries, paired exactly with their negatives, then one fixed permutation assigns the paired phase-space tuples to the neutrino lattice.
phase_space_design.q_sampling: For each state p(q) proportional to q^2 F_state(q); identical midpoint stratified quantiles are used across states, duplicated within each antithetic direction pair, with the same fixed assignment permutation.

observables.Fourier_convention: For particle positions x, C_n=2 mean cos(n k x), S_n=2 mean sin(n k x).
observables.cold_mode_response: Same Rcos definition evaluated on PartType1, reported separately for each neutrino state.

preregistered_science_gate.note: No minimum hidden contrast relative to FD is imposed. PASS means numerically resolved state-dependent response, not observational relevance.

stopping_rule: If the fine/coarse hidden contrast fails sign or convergence/null-floor gates, do not tune A, k, pair direction, softening, or resolution to recover a signal within K01E1. Diagnose and define any new experiment separately.
